summary: Reproduced the role-dependent rejection of multiple text content parts in generate_chat_conv and changed system and assistant list handling to concatenate text parts while continuing to reject non-text parts. An upstream candidate PR (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38008) was open but not merged when investigated.

tests.what_was_measured: Captured successful string system content and ValueError failures for two-part system and assistant text content in evidence/reproduction-before.txt.
All 80 conversation parser tests passed, including multi-part system/assistant concatenation, empty system content, and non-text rejection boundaries.
Confirmed exact concatenated system and assistant strings, empty-list behavior, and rejection of mixed system text/image content in evidence/reproduction-after.txt.
Both modified Python files compiled successfully.
All applicable repository formatting and lint hooks passed after formatter updates.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect reproduces deterministically in request parsing before model or GPU execution; no GPU claim is needed or made.

remaining_limitations: No HTTP server or full-model serving reproduction was run; parser-level execution covers the failing implementation path without weights.
No model architecture, semantic accuracy, distributed workload, or GPU kernel behavior was evaluated because the correction is limited to chat request content parsing.
Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38008 independently proposes a closely related correction and remained open during this investigation.
